_source: Transcribed from the captured varanasi.uk private-dining pages, Sept 2026. Capacities, deposits and hire charges are the client's own published figures.

birmingham.name: Main Dining Hall
birmingham.setMenuNote: Shahi or Dawat Set Menu (tasting menu)
birmingham.headline: A Grand, Immersive Dining Experience
birmingham.description: The Main Dining Hall at Varanasi offers a breathtaking setting designed to impress. With its striking décor, ambient lighting and vibrant atmosphere, this expansive space provides the perfect backdrop for large-scale celebrations and unforgettable dining experiences. Available for exclusive hire, the hall can be transformed to suit a variety of occasions — offering complete privacy, personalised service, and a commanding space that elevates any event.
birmingham.tagline: A breathtaking setting for large-scale celebrations, available for exclusive hire.

birmingham.name: Nirvana Cocktail Lounge
birmingham.headline: A Beautiful & Tranquil Event Setting
birmingham.description: The Nirvana Cocktail Lounge welcomes guests into a serene, atmospheric space enhanced by a stunning 20ft waterfall and calming energy. Perfect for vibrant, informal gatherings, this spacious and visually captivating area is ideal for parties, drinks receptions, or pre-dinner cocktails before seating in the main restaurant.
birmingham.tagline: Enjoy casual drinking and nibbles underneath the 20ft waterfall.

birmingham.name: Siddhartha Dining Room
birmingham.setMenuNote: Dawat Set Menu at £65.00 per person (tasting menu)
birmingham.headline: A Formal, Private Business Environment
birmingham.description: Ideal for corporate functions and professional gatherings, the Siddhartha room provides an exclusive, private setting for up to 20 guests. Equipped with a wall-mounted 42" screen, this room is designed to support meetings, presentations and corporate dining in comfort and style.
birmingham.tagline: An exclusive, formal space for corporate events and larger groups.

birmingham.name: Large Family Room
birmingham.setMenuNote: Shahi or Dawat Set Menu (tasting menu)
birmingham.headline: A Spacious & Elegant Setting for Grand Celebrations
birmingham.description: The Large Family Room is the ideal space for hosting sizable gatherings while still enjoying the exclusivity and sophistication of private dining at Varanasi. With its refined décor and welcoming atmosphere, it lends itself perfectly to a wide range of events — from milestone celebrations to family reunions and festive occasions.
birmingham.tagline: Dine comfortably inside this large, unique, personal space for families.

birmingham.name: Samsara Room
birmingham.setMenuNote: Dawat Set Menu at £65.00 per person (tasting menu)
birmingham.headline: A Warm & Relaxed Setting
birmingham.description: The Samsara room is an intimate space ideal for medium-sized gatherings. Designed with comfort in mind, it offers a cosy environment where guests can enjoy a relaxed dining experience while still embracing the vibrant atmosphere of Varanasi.
birmingham.tagline: A cosy room for family and friends.

birmingham.name: Small Family Room
birmingham.setMenuNote: Shahi or Dawat Set Menu (tasting menu)
birmingham.headline: An Intimate Group Dining Space
birmingham.description: Created with families and close-knit groups in mind, the Small Family Room is perfect for intimate celebrations. Its warm and private setting accommodates up to 30 guests, offering a sophisticated fine dining experience for special occasions.
birmingham.tagline: A warm, private setting for close-knit groups.

birmingham.name: Maharaja Room
birmingham.setMenuNote: Dawat Set Menu at £65.00 per person (tasting menu)
birmingham.headline: A Cosy, Relaxed Dining Experience
birmingham.description: This beautifully appointed private room accommodates up to 8 guests and combines intimacy with comfort. Tucked away from the main dining area, the Maharaja room offers a warm, inviting ambience with lounge-style seating, perfect for relaxed, informal celebrations.
birmingham.tagline: Lounge-style seating for relaxed, informal celebrations.

birmingham.name: Raja Rani
birmingham.setMenuNote: Dawat Set Menu at £65.00 per person (tasting menu)
birmingham.headline: Luxurious, Intimate & Memorable
birmingham.description: The Raja–Rani room offers a truly exclusive setting designed for intimate occasions and refined dining experiences. Perfect for couples seeking a luxurious, private space, this room provides an elegant atmosphere and personalised service away from the main restaurant.
birmingham.tagline: An exclusive table for two, away from the main restaurant.

leicester.name: Private Room 01
leicester.setMenuNote: Dawat Set Menu at £65.00 per person (tasting menu)
leicester.headline: A Cosy, Relaxed Dining Experience
leicester.description: This beautifully appointed private room accommodates up to 8 guests and blends intimacy with comfort. Tucked away from the main dining area, Private Room 1 exudes a warm, inviting ambience with lounge-style seating perfect for relaxed, informal celebrations.
leicester.tagline: An intimate, elegant space for up to eight guests.

leicester.name: Private Room 02
leicester.setMenuNote: Dawat Set Menu at £65.00 per person (tasting menu)
leicester.headline: Stylish and Versatile
leicester.description: A chic, flexible space designed for private dining or small business gatherings. With sleek décor and comfortable seating for up to 8 guests, the Contemporary Suite provides a sophisticated yet relaxed atmosphere for any occasion.
leicester.tagline: Exquisite cuisine and impeccable service for up to eight guests.
